summary: Tracks the index of the selected tab after insert, remove, and reverse operations on a tab strip.

traps.quote: reverse the order of all tabs at positions from left through right - 1
traps.consequence: Off-by-one error: reversing [left, right] inclusive instead of [left, right) exclusive
traps.guard: Implement half-open interval as list[left:right], not list[left:right+1]

traps.quote: select the first surviving tab to its right; if none exists, select the last surviving tab to its left
traps.consequence: Selects wrong tab if left-first precedence applied or order reversed
traps.guard: Search right strictly before left; apply conditions in exact stated order, first-match-wins

traps.quote: Selection remains attached to the same identifier.
traps.consequence: Position-based tracking breaks: selected index shifts when tabs inserted/removed before it
traps.guard: Track selected by identifier ID, not position; recompute position from current order each operation

traps.quote: use the order immediately before this operation and disregard every removed tab other than the selected tab
traps.consequence: Using post-removal positions for right/left search yields wrong surviving tab
traps.guard: Cache pre-removal order before applying removes; search direction from pre-removal position

traps.quote: if none survives, leave the strip unselected. If the strip was empty, the first inserted becomes selected.
traps.consequence: Crash or logic error if code assumes selection always exists; -1 to id transition broken
traps.guard: Handle selected_id == -1 state throughout; insert correctly transitions empty strip to selected

traps.quote: Reversed ranges have no bound on their combined length.
traps.consequence: Naive reversal per operation could TLE: 200k ops × 300k items quadratic cost
traps.guard: Ensure each operation is O(n) amortized; avoid rebuilding entire list per reverse

input_shape: initial_ids list, selected_index int, operations list. Total IDs ≤300k across inserts. Operations ≤200k.
output_shape: List of integers: zero-based selected tab index, or -1 if no tab selected, after each operation.
invariants: All identifiers distinct; never reused after removal
At most one tab selected; selection stays with same identifier through all operations
Remove with all-tabs-removed leaves strip unselected; next insert selects first
max_scale: 300,000 total identifiers, 200,000 operations, unbounded reverse range lengths
